_comment: Example only. Copy the keyword_rules array below into your own ~/.config/atlas-recall/config.json under the 'keyword_rules' key -- don't inherit these literal rules, they're not yours. Each entry is [keywords, rule_line]; if the prompt contains any keyword, rule_line gets echoed into the hook's context.
keyword_rules: RULE: never `git push` / open a PR without an explicit go-ahead this session.
RULE: proofread outward-facing text before sending; no placeholder text left in.
RULE: stage specific paths only, never a blanket add-everything.
